doc: The sunflower (sunflower_gen.js): cane stalk, spiral heart-leaves, one nodding head — seed-disc lathe (Skye's highpoly cut + baked), ray-petal card ring, bract star behind — all on the ONE sunflower_ trim sheet. Pair with `rows` for a planted field. Stiffer cane than corn, and the heavy head barely flutters.
